id: 49_What are examples of biosecurity threats in a lab biosecurity biosafety laborato
title: 实验室生物安保：五种威胁怎么防（国内版）
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/49_What are examples of biosecurity threats in a lab biosecurity biosafety laborato.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/49_What are examples of biosecurity threats in a lab biosecurity biosafety laborato（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 生物安保：防盗用、防滥用，人人有责
points.K4: 威胁三：丢失和记录不全
points.K6: 威胁五：信息被网络入侵
points.S1: 发现异常行为：报告，不私查
points.S2: 最后离开：锁柜关门查一遍
points.S3: 实验电脑：账号不共享，离开锁屏

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一扇带门禁的实验室门前，手里拿着一把钥匙，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab door with a card reader, holding a key and waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 实验室的东西，也要防丢防盗。
overlay: 实验室生物安保：五种威胁怎么防

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 五个空白格子依次亮起，每格一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Five blank boxes light up one by one, each with a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 今天认识五种生物安保威胁。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 晚上，阿杰在实验室加班，门口有个陌生人形剪影跟着别人进门
shots.prompt_en: In the evening the young male student works late; at the door a shadowy unknown figure slips in behind someone else.
shots.narration: 阿杰晚上加班，门口跟进来一个陌生人。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 冷冻盒里有一个空位，阿杰盯着空位，记录本上没有记录
shots.prompt_en: A freezer box has one empty slot; the young male student stares at it beside a blank logbook with no entry.
shots.narration: 冰箱里少了一管样本，本子上没记。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，犹豫要不要说
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, hesitating.
shots.narration: 他想：要不要说？会不会小题大做？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣出现在阿杰身边，举起电话图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot appears beside the young male student, holding up a phone icon.
shots.narration: 欣欣说：这正是生物安保要管的事。

shots.section_title: 生物安保：防盗用、防滥用，人人有责
shots.scene: 左边一个盾牌护着人，右边一个锁锁着培养瓶
shots.prompt_en: On the left a shield protects a person; on the right a padlock secures a culture flask. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全防意外，生物安保防人为。
overlay: 生物安保：防盗用、防滥用，人人有责

shots.section_title: 生物安保：防盗用、防滥用，人人有责
shots.scene: 菌种管、记录本、门禁卡、电脑四个图标围成一圈，中间一把锁
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sample tube, a logbook, an access card and a computer form a circle around a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 要守住材料、记录、门禁和信息。

shots.section_title: 生物安保：防盗用、防滥用，人人有责
shots.scene: 几个人一起托起一组齿轮
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student lift a set of gears together.
shots.narration: 这件事，要全组一起来做。

shots.section_title: 威胁一：材料被盗
shots.scene: 带锁的冷冻柜图标，旁边一个伸来的手被红叉挡住
shots.prompt_en: A locked freezer icon; a reaching hand is blocked by a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 第一种：生物材料被盗。

shots.section_title: 威胁一：材料被盗
shots.scene: 被盗的材料流向一个红色问号
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube icon drifts away toward a red question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 落到坏人手里，后果不堪设想。

shots.section_title: 威胁一：材料被盗
shots.scene: 王老师给冷冻柜上锁，旁边空白登记本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator locks a freezer, with a blank logbook beside it.
shots.narration: 高风险材料，专柜专锁，专人管。

shots.section_title: 威胁一：材料被盗
shots.scene: 两排台阶方向相反，国内一侧最高级标红
shots.prompt_en: Two staircases going opposite directions; the top step on the domestic side is red. No people.
shots.narration: 国内第一类最危险，保藏要审批。

shots.section_title: 威胁二：内部人员滥用
shots.scene: 一个人形剪影在实验室门内，阴影笼罩着样本柜
shots.prompt_en: A faceless figure silhouette inside the lab casts a shadow over a sample cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 第二种：内部人员滥用。

shots.section_title: 威胁二：内部人员滥用
shots.scene: 三个小图标：深夜月亮、不登记的手、超量的管子
shots.prompt_en: Three small icons: a late-night moon, a hand skipping the logbook, too many tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 反常领用、不登记、乱时段出入。

shots.section_title: 威胁二：内部人员滥用
shots.scene: 老周和组员讨论，桌上空白的双人核对表
shots.prompt_en: The older man talks with the team, a blank two-person check sheet on the table.
shots.narration: 关键材料，双人核对，互相监督。

shots.section_title: 威胁三：丢失和记录不全
shots.scene: 冷冻盒里有空位，记录本上一片空白
shots.prompt_en: A freezer box with an empty slot next to a blank, unfilled logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 第三种：丢失和记录不全。
overlay: 威胁三：丢失和记录不全

shots.section_title: 威胁三：丢失和记录不全
shots.scene: 问号飘在冷冻盒上方
shots.prompt_en: A question mark floats above the freezer box. No people.
shots.narration: 账上没记，丢了都不知道。

shots.section_title: 威胁三：丢失和记录不全
shots.scene: 小研在空白台账上逐管登记，取用后签名
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student logs each tube in a blank inventory ledger and signs after taking one.
shots.narration: 入库、取用、销毁，件件登记。

shots.section_title: 威胁三：丢失和记录不全
shots.scene: 日历图标和清点动作，台账与实物一一对应
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon; tubes in the box are matched one by one to entries in the ledger. No people.
shots.narration: 定期盘点，账物相符。

shots.section_title: 威胁四：未经授权进入
shots.scene: 实验室门上的门禁和生物危害标志，一个人尾随溜入被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab door with a card reader and biohazard warning sign; a figure tailgating through is crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 第四种：未经授权进入。

shots.section_title: 威胁四：未经授权进入
shots.scene: 门禁卡借给别人的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of handing an access card to another person, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 门禁卡不外借，不让人尾随。

shots.section_title: 威胁四：未经授权进入
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员在登记处给访客登记，小研陪同
shots.prompt_en: The security officer registers a visitor at the desk while the female graduate student escorts.
shots.narration: 访客登记，全程有人陪同。

shots.section_title: 威胁五：信息被网络入侵
shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上一个数据库图标，一条红色虚线从外面伸进来
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen shows a database icon; a red dashed line reaches in from outside. No people.
shots.narration: 第五种：信息被网络入侵。
overlay: 威胁五：信息被网络入侵

shots.section_title: 威胁五：信息被网络入侵
shots.scene: 菌种信息、实验记录两个文件图标被锁保护
shots.prompt_en: Two document icons for strain records and lab notes are protected by a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 菌种和实验信息，也要保护。

shots.section_title: 威胁五：信息被网络入侵
shots.scene: 陌生邮件附件图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an unknown email attachment, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 陌生链接、附件，不点不开。

shots.section_title: 威胁五：信息被网络入侵
shots.scene: 老李在给服务器设置密码锁，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sets a password lock on a server; the screen is blank.
shots.narration: 设权限、做备份，按学校网络规定办。

shots.section_title: 发现异常行为：报告，不私查
shots.scene: 阿杰看到异常情况，皱眉思考
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices something unusual and frowns.
shots.narration: 觉得不对劲，别憋在心里。
overlay: 发现异常行为：报告，不私查

shots.section_title: 发现异常行为：报告，不私查
shots.scene: 跟踪、翻柜子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of secretly following someone and searching a cabinet, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 不跟踪，不私下调查。

shots.section_title: 发现异常行为：报告，不私查
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告，老周认真听
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man, who listens carefully.
shots.narration: 如实告诉实验室负责人。

shots.section_title: 发现异常行为：报告，不私查
shots.scene: 逐级报告的箭头：实验室、学院、学校、保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show reporting steps: lab, department, university, security office. No people.
shots.narration: 再报学院、学校和保卫处。

shots.section_title: 发现异常行为：报告，不私查
shots.scene: 嘴巴贴封条的图标，旁边几个传话气泡被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A sealed-lips icon next to gossip speech bubbles crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 不在群里传，不乱猜测。

shots.section_title: 最后离开：锁柜关门查一遍
shots.scene: 小研最后离开，挨个检查冰箱锁、试剂柜锁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, last to leave, checks the freezer lock and cabinet lock one by one.
shots.narration: 最后离开的人，锁好柜子。
overlay: 最后离开：锁柜关门查一遍

shots.section_title: 最后离开：锁柜关门查一遍
shots.scene: 小研关窗、关门，门锁咔哒一声
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the window and the door, and the lock clicks.
shots.narration: 关好门窗，再检查一遍。

shots.section_title: 最后离开：锁柜关门查一遍
shots.scene: 空白离开检查表上逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: Items on a blank leaving checklist get ticked one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 按清单逐项打勾签名。

shots.section_title: 实验电脑：账号不共享，离开锁屏
shots.scene: 电脑前便利贴上写着密码的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a password sticky note on a monitor, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 密码不贴在屏幕上。
overlay: 实验电脑：账号不共享，离开锁屏

shots.section_title: 实验电脑：账号不共享，离开锁屏
shots.scene: 两人共用一个账号的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two people sharing one login, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 账号一人一个，不共享。

shots.section_title: 实验电脑：账号不共享，离开锁屏
shots.scene: 小研起身离开时按下锁屏键，屏幕变成锁形图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the lock key as she stands up; the screen shows a padlock icon.
shots.narration: 离开座位，随手锁屏。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拨通电话，老周和保卫处值班员赶到实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student makes a call; the older man and the security officer arrive at the lab.
shots.narration: 阿杰报告了，负责人和保卫处赶来。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老周对照台账清点，保卫处值班员查看门禁记录图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks the ledger while the security officer reviews an access log icon.
shots.narration: 核对台账和门禁，查清去向。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，五个盾牌依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard where five shield icons light up one by one.
shots.narration: 被盗、内部滥用、丢失、闯入、网络。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 三个图标：眼睛、锁、电话
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an eye, a padlock, a phone. No people.
shots.narration: 识别迹象，做好预防，及时报告。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 全组成员托起齿轮，齿轮转动
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student hold up the gears, which start turning.
shots.narration: 生物安保，靠每个人守住。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣锁好柜门，转身向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot locks a cabinet door, turns and waves goodbye to the camera.
shots.narration: 发现异常及时报，再见！
